guard pending-write placement callers, if the signature moves

summary: The guard's pending-write placement reaches local documents exactly as check's discovery does, so a CLAUDE.local.md inside an ignored build/ is a member of neither
acceptance: A pending write to build/CLAUDE.local.md inside an ignored build/ is placed as no memory-local member, as check discovers none there; a local document the locus names literally is still placed
tests: guard places no memory local member inside an ignored directory a wildcard never descends
notes: From the ONE-FENCED-TREE-INDEX-PER-RUN build note: check's Reach scan moved, discovers_path did not. One discovery, two readers.
